title: October 2026 Releases
description: conda 26.10.0 makes Rattler the default solver, ships the classic solver as conda-pycosat-solver, and updates libmamba and py-rattler.

title: Security updates for conda, Mamba, and Pixi
description: Update conda, Mamba, Pixi, and CA packages after the eMudhra certificate compromise.

title: August and September 2026 Releases
description: conda and conda-build 26.9.0 are out, with native Windows ARM64 launchers, package timestamp filtering, v1 recipe fixes, and more releases since July.

title: June and July 2026 Releases
description: June and July releases across the conda org: conda and conda-build 26.7.0, constructor 3.16, libmamba and conda-pypi updates, faster solves in rattler, and more. 🎉

title: Bridging conda and PyPI ecosystems: Install PyPI packages with conda install
description: conda-pypi beta enables conda CLI to install pure Python packages from PyPI natively and alongside conda packages in a single dependency solve, without a separate pip step
